title: Weeknight trading to 9pm in metropolitan Perth (WA)
summary: The Retail Trading Hours Amendment Act 2010 let general retail shops in the Perth metropolitan area open until 9pm on weeknights, from 1 November 2010.

commenced.what: Optional 9pm weeknight trading for general retail shops across metropolitan Perth

direction_rationale: Longer permitted trading hours let smaller and new retailers compete with incumbents on convenience and give consumers more choice; the PC recommended full deregulation. Effects may favour large chains able to staff extra hours.
comparison: States with unchanged trading hours (SA, QLD) and non-metro WA; Victoria/ACT/NT already deregulated
price_series: Food and non-alcoholic beverages (group); Garments for women; Garments for men
notes: Perth-only treatment: regional WA a within-state control if CABEE can be split by region (it is by SA2/LGA in some releases).
